heroHeadline: Record 2026 Wildfire Season Scorches Over 4 Million Hectares Across Canada
heroSubtitle: 4,082,237 hectares burned across 4,654 fires as of 12 August; 5 dead, 36+ injured, 24,000+ evacuated including all 12,000 residents of Summerland, BC. Smoke has pushed AQI to record highs across 18 US states, with Milwaukee hitting 644 on 16 July and Toronto recording the world's worst air quality on 15 July.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
